items.question: How is the cost of cleaning calculated?
items.answer: The price depends on the area, cleaning type, number of bathrooms, selected add-on services, urgency and frequency of visits. Use the calculator on the site — it shows an exact price range in 30 seconds, no calls needed.

items.question: Do I need to buy cleaning products or provide equipment?
items.answer: No. Cleaners arrive with their own professional products, vacuum cleaners, microfiber cloths and all the necessary equipment. You don't need to prepare anything in advance.

items.question: When do I need to pay for the cleaning?
items.answer: After the work is finished and you've personally checked the result. We don't take prepayment for apartment cleaning — it's part of our commitment to client trust.

items.question: What if I'm not happy with the quality of the cleaning?
items.answer: If, for objective reasons, the work wasn't completed properly or has flaws, we'll redo the problem areas free of charge within 24 hours of the cleaning.

items.question: Can I be away from home during the cleaning?
items.answer: Yes, many clients grant access via an intercom code, a concierge or neighbors. Cleaners take photos of the result when finished, and payment happens in whatever way is convenient for you.

items.question: How quickly can I book a cleaner?
items.answer: For urgent bookings, a team can arrive the same day or the next — an urgency surcharge applies to the price for this. For regular bookings, we recommend booking 1–2 days ahead.

items.question: Do you work on weekends and holidays?
items.answer: Yes, we work every day without days off, including holidays, during the hours listed on the site.

items.question: Do you vet your cleaners before hiring them?
items.answer: Yes, every cleaner goes through document verification and an interview before being allowed to work with clients — this is part of our safety policy.

items.question: Which areas do you serve?
items.answer: We cover all of Bishkek and nearby suburbs — Kant, Lebedinovka, Voenno-Antonovka. See the full list of districts in the "Areas we serve" section.

items.question: Can I book cleaning for just one room or area, like the kitchen?
items.answer: Yes, mention in the request comment that you only need a specific area cleaned — we'll calculate the price individually based on that area.
